Length distributions of the rule from a collected table

Source: R/ldist.R
rule_ldist.Rd

Selects the gears, years and lengths of the rule from a length distribution by year, gear and length (such as catch_ldist(by_gear = TRUE)), sums it by year and length, and optionally adds other length distributions (e.g. survey lengths in years without catch samples).

Usage

rule_ldist(
  ldist,
  gears = NULL,
  year_start = NULL,
  max_length = NULL,
  extra = NULL
)

Arguments

ldist

A data frame with the columns year, length and n, and mfdb_gear_code if gears is given.

gears

mfdb gear codes to keep, or NULL for all.

year_start

First year to keep, or NULL for all.

max_length

Keep lengths strictly below this, or NULL for all (e.g. to drop a mis-entered length).

extra

NULL, or a data frame with the columns year, length and n that is added to the selected distribution before the final sum.

Value

A tibble with the columns year, length and n, sorted by year and length.
